originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&xGridSpacing` is never used.

model:
(define-fun AUTO_BED_LEVELING_GRID () Bool
  false)
(define-fun ENABLE_AUTO_BED_LEVELING () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_20/50 etc. (e30bfedce4d.c, Marlin auto bed leveling). Dead store on 'xGridSpacing' at line 24. When AUTO_BED_LEVELING_GRID=false, the known vbdb UndeclaredIdentifier bug fires (xGridSpacing and other grid variables are only declared inside #ifdef AUTO_BED_LEVELING_GRID but used when ENABLE_AUTO_BED_LEVELING=true). The tool treats the undeclared identifier as 0 and reports a spurious dead store instead of the real UndeclaredIdentifier bug. Simplification artifact / tool failure to detect real bug.
